p1.finding: No area-matched Fixed RTL with identical framing, storage, FIFO, frequency target and interface was evaluated.
p1.impact: The verified 24/39/1618 cycle values are module latency evidence, not an acceleration result.

p1.finding: This independent review intentionally ran no DC/STA/SAIF/PTPX and has no matched macro-aware physical comparison.
p1.impact: Frequency, area, power and energy remain outside admission.

p1.finding: The arithmetic campaign uses two high-signal synthetic configurations rather than frozen checkpoint-derived rank-3 factors and representative ordered traces.
p1.impact: Deployable range, accuracy and workload performance remain unadmitted.

p2.finding: Two inserted configuration bubbles change N1 latency from 24 to 26 cycles.
p2.impact: Any 5N+19 wording must retain N>=1, gap-free traffic and result_ready-high assumptions.

p2.finding: The 1618-cycle N40 result is tied to one fixed one-cycle-in-eight result_ready phase schedule.
p2.impact: It is neither a general backpressure bound nor a worst-case latency.

p2.finding: The repair is covered by directed independent VCS and SVA, not formal equivalence or constrained-random fault-phase exploration.
p2.impact: Evidence is strong for the attacked boundaries but not exhaustive.

p2.finding: Sticky quarantine intentionally retains in-flight banks, product state and FIFO contents until reset; no flush or recovery transaction exists.
p2.impact: The wrapper must guarantee reset before context reuse after protocol_error.

paper_safe_wording.admissible: Exact-SHA Synopsys VCS independently reproduced 24- and 39-cycle clean standalone latencies for N=1 and N=4 and 1618 cycles for one fixed one-in-eight-ready N=40 schedule. Across 1618 legal half-cycle probes, all six configuration phases and all five raw/result phases completed with no protocol pulse, intra-half control/result change, numeric mismatch or order mismatch. Directed fault-edge testing showed that a malformed raw payload was not committed while already-established same-edge FIFO push and result pop completed consistently, followed by sticky reset-only quarantine.
paper_safe_wording.required_caveat: These are standalone module correctness and latency results, not speedup, PPA, energy, checkpoint, accuracy or system results.
